title: F422 Interface Router Area vs Point Scope Command Behavior on MH200

environment.bus_topology: Main SCS bus with F422 interface router on domain 02

device_under_test.description: SCS bus interface router (configured as private interface 02)

summary: Empirical observation of F422 interface router behavior on an MH200 gateway. Area scope status request (*#2*1#4#02##) is forwarded and answered with individual per-point status frames for covers 11, 12, and 13. Area scope command (*2*1*1#4#02##) receives gateway socket ACK (*#*1##) but produces no cover movement or events from interface 02. In contrast, point command (*2*1*11#4#02##) is echoed and results in actuator movement ending in STOP after 60.9s run-time.
test_recipe: 1. Send area status request *#2*1#4#02## targeting area 1 behind interface 02.
2. Observe per-point RX replies for covers 11, 12, 13 (*2*0*11#4#02##, etc.).
3. Dispatch area UP command *2*1*1#4#02##; observe gateway socket ACK *#*1## with no subsequent movement events.
4. Dispatch point UP command *2*1*11#4#02## to cover 11; observe bus echo *2*1*11#4#02##.
5. Observe cover run-time completion: actuator reports STOP *2*0*11#4#02## 60.9s later.
